description: This file provides a client-side API wrapper for making HTTP requests to a backend server, including functions for health checks, listing users, sessions, deployments, analytics, and costs. It includes internal helpers for URL building, query parameter sanitization, and response parsing.

methods.name: getApiClient
methods.description: Returns an axios-like client with methods for get, post, put, delete using fetch.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a backend health check, trying the root endpoint first, then fallback to /api/auth/health.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Fetches a list of users, only sending organization_id, returns normalized { items, total, meta }.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Fetches session tracking records with tenant scope via tenant_id, returns normalized { items, total, meta }.

methods.name: listDeployments
methods.description: Fetches app deployment data, returns normalized { items, total, meta }.

methods.name: listDashboardUsersAnalytics
methods.description: Fetches aggregated per-user analytics data from /api/dashboard/users.

methods.name: listLlmCosts
methods.description: Fetches LLM cost records from /api/llm-costs, normalized to { items, total, meta }.

methods.name: listLlmCostsUnderscore
methods.description: Fetches LLM costs with support for envelope structure, fallback to raw array.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummaryStrict
methods.description: Calls /api/users/tenant-summary ensuring only organization_id is sent as a query parameter.
